iko.text: Zeph, bonded monster of Barrow, joins a gathering of bonders and allies in the wilds, and after hearing Lukka and Vivien, Barrow becomes convinced action is needed about the Ozolith.

In the Battle at the Ozolith, Zeph attacks the largest nightmare while Barrow channels lightning through their bond, but the nightmares turn on the hunters and Lukka returns transformed, announcing he controls the monsters.
Barrow insists that Zeph is his partner, not a subordinate, and when Lukka tries to control Zeph through the Ozolith and fails, they flee at Vivien's order and make their way back to Drannith.
During the Siege of Drannith, Barrow and Zeph lead the bonded charge through the main gate to rescue Jirina and turn the tide, and afterward they help normalize monsters among people.
